questions.scenario: Two brothers are watching sports on TV.
questions.question:
Older brother: Look at the player! Can you run like him?
Younger brother: ___________________
options: No, I am not. I am too slow.
Yes, I can. I am too slow.
Yes, I do. I am too slow.
No, I can't. I am too slow.
questions.explanation: 因為回答『我太慢了』，所以不可能做到，必須以否定句簡答。問句用 Can you...?，否定短答為 No, I can't.。選項 B 誤用 Be 動詞；選項 C 前後語意矛盾；選項 D 誤用助動詞 do。
questions.commonMisconception: 對於 Can 提問，被母語干擾回答 『No, I am not.』，或是沒有結合後方語意 (too slow) 判斷出必須是否定回答。

questions.scenario: A gym teacher is asking a student during class.
questions.question:
Teacher: Can you jump high, Andy?
Andy: ___________________
options: No, I don't. Look at me!
Yes, I can. Look at me!
Yes, I am. Look at me!
Yes, you can. Look at me
questions.explanation: 助動詞 Can you...? 提問，必須使用 Yes, I can.。選項 B 的 I am 和選項 D 的 I don't 都是錯誤的助動詞對應。選項 C 沒有將 you 換成 I。
questions.commonMisconception: 被口語常見的 I am 誤導，忘記在問答中需要助動詞對應。

questions.scenario: Friends are talking about a bird they see outside.
questions.question:
Sarah: The little bird has hurt wings. _______________
John: No, it can't.
questions.explanation: 從約定俗成的簡答 No, it can't. 推判問句必須以 Can 開頭且主詞為 it。選項 B 將 is 與原形動詞 fly 疊加；選項 C 用錯了助動詞 does；選項 D 主詞錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法從回答的 can't 回推問句的結構，或是在看選項時看到中文意思對就選了 Is it fly 這種錯誤句型。

questions.scenario: A magic show is happening at the park.
questions.question:
Magician: I have a magic cat. It can dance.
Boy: Wow! ___________________
questions.explanation: 男孩對於這隻貓的能力感到好奇。因為敘述句是『It can dance.』，順接去問其他能力自然該用『Can it sing...?』。選項 B 是雙動詞錯誤；選項 C 語境不精準；選項 D 主詞變成問魔術師了。
questions.commonMisconception: 在對話的情境延伸中，無法繼續維持原本的話語焦點 (it / can)。

questions.scenario: Mom is asking Jimmy to reach for something on a high shelf.
questions.question:
Mom: Can you reach the book for me?
Jimmy: No, I can't. ___________________
options: I am not jump that high
questions.explanation: 前半句已說 No, I can't.，後半句解釋原因時，同樣要用表示能力的 can't。選項 B, D 錯字連篇 (am not/isn't 加動詞原形)；選項 C do not 不表能力。
questions.commonMisconception: 解釋理由時，助動詞切換錯亂，把 am not + 原形動詞當作否定句的萬靈丹。

questions.scenario: Two students are reading a comic book about superheroes.
questions.question:
Student A: The red hero is strong.
Student B: Yes, he is. Can he fly?
Student A: ___________________
questions.explanation: 問句是 Can he fly?，簡答必須是 Yes, he can.。選項 B 誤用 Be 動詞；選項 C 誤用 do 助動詞；選項 D 誤用人稱代名詞 I。
questions.commonMisconception: 被前面的『Yes, he is.』對話干擾，順著口頭禪也回答『Yes, he is.』。

questions.scenario: A girl brings her new dog to the playground.
questions.question:
Jenny: Meet my new dog, Max. He is very smart.
Mark: ___________________
Jenny: Yes, he can catch a ball.
questions.explanation: Jenny 在講述這隻小狗 (Max，擬人化用 he 代表) 的才藝。回答說『Yes, he can catch...』，顯示前面 Mark 問的是能力。而主詞要用 he。選項 B 是嚴重文法錯誤；選項 D 的 it 與 Jenny 叫 he 沒對上。
questions.commonMisconception: 看見 animal 就死板板要選 it，沒注意到情境中對話對象把寵物擬人稱呼 he。

questions.scenario: During art class, a kid looks at his friend's notebook.
questions.question:
Kid A: Wow! You can draw a big robot.
Kid B: Yes, I can. ___________________
options: And I can draw a car, too.
And you can draw a car.
And I draw a car, too.
And I am draw a car, too.
questions.explanation: 接續前面的 Yes, I can. (是的，我會)，Kid B 想順勢說出自己『也會』做什麼。因此使用 can 加原形動詞是最自然的表述。選項 B 是雙動詞錯誤；選項 C 雖文法可通但缺乏助動詞的力道；選項 D 改變主詞不符邏輯。
questions.commonMisconception: 在延續長句子表達時，常常把 Be 動詞加到原形動詞前面 (I am draw...)。

questions.scenario: A brother is asking his older sister to help him with sports.
questions.question:
Brother: ___________________
Sister: No, I can't. Ask Dad for help.
questions.explanation: 從姊姊的回答『No, I can't.』可得知問句必定是以 Can you...? 開頭。選項 B 與 D 皆為 Be 動詞加原形動詞的錯誤結構。選項 C 的 Do you 在文意與回答都不匹配。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒看清楚下半句回答的提示，被中文『你打棒球嗎？』干擾而選擇 Are you。

questions.scenario: A girl is talking to a zookeeper near the penguin area.
questions.question:
Girl: Penguins have wings. Can they fly?
Zookeeper: ___________________
questions.explanation: 問句主詞是 penguins (they複數)，以 Can 提問。企鵝不會飛，所以是否定回答。正確配對為 No, they can't.。選項 B 的 aren't 動詞錯誤；選項 C, D 是前後自相矛盾的句子。
questions.commonMisconception: 答題時被『翅膀(wings)』的意象干擾而忘記基本常識，或否定時錯用 aren't 代替 can't。

questions.scenario: Phonics check: Teacher is pointing at a picture of a kitten.
questions.question: Teacher: Listen! /c/-/a/-/t/, cat. What is the sound of 'a' in 'cat'?
questions.explanation: 單音節單字 cat 中的 a 發短母音 /æ/。這是三下 Phonics 的重點內容。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆長短母音的發音邏輯。

questions.scenario: At the park, seeing a beautiful bird.
questions.question:
A: Look! A yellow bird.
B: __________________
A: Yes, it can fly very high.
questions.explanation: 根據回答『Yes, it can...』反推問句應為 Can it...?。選項 A 雙動詞錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 受母語影響誤用 Is it + V。

questions.scenario: Two friends playing a guessing game.
questions.question:
A: I'm a rabbit. Can I jump?
B: __________________
questions.explanation: 問句 Can I...? 詢問對方，對方應回答 Yes, you can.。選項 D 人稱錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 人稱代名詞 I 與 You 的對應轉換失敗。

questions.scenario: Talking about talents in a talent show.
questions.question:
A: Can your sister dance?
B: __________________. She is a good dancer.
questions.explanation: 後半句補充『她是好舞者』，故前面回答必須是肯定的 Yes, she can.。
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略後半句的情境提示。

questions.scenario: Phonics check: Rhyming words.
questions.question: Which word rhymes with 'can'?
questions.explanation: can 與 man 都有相同的尾音 -an。這是 Phonics 辨識發音規律的基礎。
questions.commonMisconception: 僅看字首而忽略字尾發音規律。

questions.scenario: A fish in an aquarium.
questions.question:
Boy: Can the fish swim?
Girl: __________________
questions.explanation: 魚會游泳是常識，且問句用 Can，簡答也需用 Can。選項 C 語法嚴重錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆常識與文法結構的對應。

questions.scenario: Watching a robot demonstration.
questions.question:
A: Look! The robot can walk. __________________?
B: No, it can't sing.
questions.explanation: 由回答『No, it can't sing.』可推知問句在問它會不會唱歌。選項 C 為文法錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法從否定簡答回推對應的操作動詞。

questions.scenario: A little girl trying to sing a song.
questions.question:
Mom: Can you sing the ABC song?
Girl: __________________. Please help me.
questions.explanation: 請求幫助 (Please help me) 暗示了目前無法獨立完成。選項 D 誤用 Be 動詞。
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略語境中的求救訊號而選擇肯定回答。

questions.scenario: Phonics: Letter 'e' sound.
questions.question: Which word has the short 'e' sound like in 'red'?
questions.explanation: pen 含有與 red 相同的短母音 /ɛ/。選項 B 是短母音 /ɪ/。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆 /ɛ/ 與 /ɪ/ 的發音。

questions.scenario: A coach talking to a player.
questions.question:
Coach: You are very tall. Can you play basketball?
Player: __________________. I like it very much.
questions.explanation: 『我很喜歡』支持了肯定回答。對於 Can you...? 的問句回以 Yes, I can.。
questions.commonMisconception: 在喜歡 (like) 的語境下誤用 do 助動詞回答 Can 問句。

questions.scenario: Identifying sounds of animals.
questions.question:
A: Can a pig sing?
B: __________________
questions.explanation: 豬不會唱歌是基礎常識。簡答須與問句 Can 對齊。選項 D 人稱代名詞錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 在常識判斷中忘記檢查助動詞的一致性。

questions.scenario: Two kids looking at a picture of an airplane.
questions.question:
A: Look! An airplane. Can it fly?
B: __________________
questions.explanation: 飛機會飛，且應以 can 簡答。選項 C 誤用 Be 動詞。
questions.commonMisconception: 對物理常識的認同慣性導致忽略文法結構對應。

questions.scenario: Phonics: Letter 'i' sound.
questions.question: Which word has the short 'i' sound like in 'big'?
questions.explanation: pig 含有短母音 /ɪ/。選項 B 為短母音 /ɛ/。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆 /ɪ/ 與 /ɛ/ 的字母拼顯與發音對應。

questions.scenario: Grandma is watching her grandson swim.
questions.question:
Grandma: Wow! __________________
Grandson: Yes, I am a good swimmer.
questions.explanation: 根據回應『Yes, I am a good swimmer.』可推知問句在確認能力。選項 B 為文法錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 見到後方用 am 回應，就想在問句選 Are you swim。需區分名詞身分與動詞能力的問法。

questions.scenario: Asking about a pet's ability.
questions.question:
A: Can your cat run fast?
B: __________________. It is very old.
questions.explanation: 因為貓很老了 (very old)，所以無法跑快。對應 Can 的問句需用 can't 否定簡答。
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略年老 (old) 隱含的生理限制，只看見 cat 就選肯定。

questions.scenario: Phonics: Short 'o' sound.
questions.question: Which word has the same 'o' sound as in 'dog'?
questions.explanation: hot 的 o 發短母音 /ɑ/，與 dog 相同。選項 B 是長母音 /o/。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆 o 的長短母音發音。

questions.scenario: Talking about a superhero.
questions.question:
A: Can Superman fly?
B: Yes, he can. __________________?
A: No, his sister can't fly.
questions.explanation: 由 A 回答『his sister can't fly』反推 B 是在詢問他姐姐。選項 C 用錯了所有格 her。
questions.commonMisconception: 在代名詞變換中混淆所有格 his 與 her 的使用。

questions.scenario: Phonics: Short 'u' sound.
questions.question: Choose the word with the short 'u' sound (/ʌ/).
questions.explanation: cup 發短母音 /ʌ/。選項 B, C 均含有長母音 /ju/。
questions.commonMisconception: 被拼字 u 的存在誤導，無法區分長短音的音標差異。

questions.scenario: A student asking a friend.
questions.question:
A: Can you dance like a robot?
B: No, I can't. Internal: I am a human, not a robot.
options: I can't dance like a robot.
如果我們仔細觀察的話會發現I am dance.
I can dance.，但其實這只是作者的想像。
questions.explanation: 前半句已說 No, I can't.，後半句應重複對能力的否定表述。選項 C 為嚴重語法錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 在否定句型中遺漏助動詞或誤加 Be 動詞。

questions.scenario: Recap: What can a monkey do?
questions.question: A monkey _________________.
questions.explanation: 猴子會爬樹是事實，正確用法為 can + 原形動詞。選項 B, D 均為文法錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 在一般陳述中誤用 Be 動詞取代助動詞的功能。
